changes.body:
Resolved prospectively by LUX-168. The exact submitted fix `6d8d7bef7679881b49bc2217d846b9533589d974`, landed through `4514291224282ebadfdc5885cc3a7e619d75161d`, restores the old unguarded `ComponentDefinition.create` annotation and introduces `AnyComponentDefinition` for code-or-graph annotations. The unchanged legacy source compiles and links, modern graph/type regressions pass, and independent review found no blockers.

Preserve the historical LUX-150 acceptance and this correction record. LUX-168 is the explicit compatibility closure for the release hold recorded here; it does not rewrite the earlier acceptance event.

Scope clarification recorded after the LUX-168 acceptance: future component migration is authorized when it preserves saved values, stable instance and Library links, and source history, with external limits disclosed. This does not undo or narrow the accepted LUX-168 compatibility fix, and it does not require a migration in LUX-168.

payload.summary: Blanket GPU-test serialization delays unrelated delivery
payload.expected: Use measured contention to coordinate tests. CPU work proceeds independently. Concurrent low-resolution functional previews are allowed when resources permit; exclusive windows are reserved for performance measurements or heavy full-resolution runs.
payload.actual: Coordinator applied one-test-at-a-time holds to all native graphics work and repeatedly mediated reservations, delaying delivery. User explicitly corrected this as overly restrictive.
payload.correction: User supersedes the historical blanket serialization rule. Default routine QA to640x360 with normal UI viewport; allow concurrent functional tests subject to resource checks. Preserve uncontended performance evidence and exact required capture resolutions. Never hold CPU implementation for a GPU slot or terminate user apps.
payload.evidence: User correction in task01a09baf-3806-7eb0-8bed-48b8b7f771cf on2026-09-16; delivery coordinator01a0a7bb acknowledged updated policy. Earlier snapshot50GB RAM free,845MiB/8192MiB VRAM used is historical, not proof of future capacity.

payload.summary: User requests faster integrated visual milestones
payload.expected: Build a substantial visual slice before QA and publication.
payload.actual: Repeated foundation captures, review and publication cycles delayed the pattern visual.
payload.correction: Prototype all six pattern families in the current five-node scene in parallel; defer review, sustained FPS, publication recovery and save/reopen QA to the integrated milestone boundary.
payload.evidence: User correction in Start Lux task on 2026-09-16; current foundation captures and review in artifacts/living-ornament.

payload.summary: Recording delivery was slow and temporal quality was not validated
payload.expected: Deliver a smooth clip quickly through programmatic recording and verify actual motion cadence.
payload.actual: User reported 15m30s turnaround and roughly one new frame every two seconds. WebM inspection found 113 frames over 84.639s; 30 FPS conversion duplicated frames. Prior validation of format and a still missed the defect.
payload.correction: User explicitly rejected computer-use automation for this workflow. Plan one-call MCP recording, decoded-cadence validation, direct-frame encoding and deterministic export under LUX-176; do not claim render FPS proves recording quality.
payload.evidence: Measured source: C:/Users/zFlei/Dropbox/VJ/Living Ornament - Companion Birds - 2026-09-16.webm. Median frame gap 0.7325s; maximum 1.256s; container duration 129.783s. Ticket receipts: artifacts/recording-roadmap.

payload.summary: Bird iteration changed flight character more than requested
payload.expected: Preserve the earlier realistic motion and address rotation jitter narrowly.
payload.actual: User reported the first new motion felt worse and excessively smoothed after tangent-based orientation replaced velocity-facing flight.
payload.correction: Restored actual velocity-facing flight and prior flap waveform; restricted orientation settling to perch transitions. Added social behavior in the same prototype pass. Avoid replacing movement character when fixing local rotation jitter.
payload.evidence: LUX-181; source82ef071e32db0df19875d7cff9d1dfce89b5c09d; artifacts/birds/social-final.png and combined-qa.json. Final measured59.76385FPS at1920x1080, nofault.

payload.summary: User caught insufficient artistic validation of hummingbird species and material
payload.expected: Visual review should assess recognizability and feather material at normal and enlarged scales.
payload.actual: Prior screenshot inspection accepted generic triangle hummingbirds with timed color shifts.
payload.correction: LUX-184 adds dedicated anatomy/material and before/after artistic iteration with independent review.

payload.summary: User correction: do not treat GPU as a single exclusive slot for background reference renders
payload.expected: Proceed with isolated background renders; coordinate only for an observed resource conflict, not a presumed global GPU lock.
payload.actual: Agent deferred ready captures to another active task and repeatedly waited for a GPU release, delaying requested images.
payload.correction: User: there is not a single GPU slot; you do not need to coordinate as much. Preserve session/profile isolation without imposing unnecessary serialization.
payload.evidence: Task 01a0ad28-e169-78d1-b8ae-3e72c9c783ec, current user correction during LUX-191/LUX-192 background rendering.

payload.summary: The accepted connected group treatment used too much vertical padding for control-dense Inspector workflows.
payload.expected: Compact groups should preserve 13px headings, contrast, borders, and usable controls while showing many controls in a normal 260px Inspector.
payload.actual: The 8px group gap, 5px summary padding, 2/5px control padding, and 5px rows accumulated too much empty height.
payload.correction: The user authorized a bounded density follow-up: tighten group, header, controls, and repeated row spacing; verify a realistic many-control Inspector.
payload.evidence: User correction relayed by root on 2026-09-16 after review of LUX-186 screenshots.

payload.expected: Save requested demo scenes in repo visuals/ and commit with the other scenes.
payload.actual: Demo files were saved only to the Codex visualization output directory.
payload.correction: Add both exact validated scenes under visuals/ and merge the reviewed branch to main as requested.

payload.summary: UI refactors need whole-panel diagnosis and real-use validation before handoff
payload.expected: Inspect representative UI states and layout ancestors, implement a compact usable path, then review actual interactions and screenshots from the final build.
payload.actual: Recent Inspector work needed repeated density corrections; Source retained an overriding file-list height cap; FPS initially read an unpopulated runtime field. Early handoffs and harness workarounds weakened evidence.
payload.correction: User authorized a global improve-ui skill. LUX-210 creates and installs the reusable workflow; effectiveness must be assessed during later use.

payload.summary: Story UI native QA blocked by intermittent Story worker startup and a harness readiness race
payload.expected: Fresh isolated 640x360 Story fixture should build reliably before UI checks.
payload.actual: The baseline fixture succeeded. Two subsequent runs failed during document build with Story worker stopped making progress; resources remain reserved. Diagnostic resolution reduction then exposed a separate harness race: the new runtime snapshot and enabled Build button precede resize settlement, so playback reports a build already running.
payload.correction: UI scope does not include runtime repair. Harness now waits for enabled resolution input with observed value 360 before continuing. Preserve watchdog and owned-process cleanup. GPU slot released for queued tasks; corrected pass pending.

payload.summary: GPU reservations were reassigned before asynchronous launch handoffs were acknowledged
payload.expected: One holder keeps its grant until explicit release and owned-process cleanup. Delayed messages must not reactivate old grants.
payload.actual: Coordinator reassigned between Story and Quasar while prior grant messages were still being acted upon. Both tasks reported launch/revocation messages crossing. Story startup watchdog failures occurred, but overlap has not been established as their cause. Runtime/harness report LUX-P121 remains separate.
payload.correction: Use one named grant held through explicit cleanup/release. Do not reassign on apparent inactivity. STORY-FINAL-1 granted only after Quasar confirmed paused; subsequent launches require separately named grant.
payload.evidence: Coordinator thread 01a09baf-3806-7eb0-8bed-48b8b7f771cf; Story task 01a0b1b1-d61f-74c3-8b01-1c0824900016; Quasar task 01a0ad1f-9ae2-7e40-80d1-c7bdbf32b1e2. Handoff messages 17 September 2026 local time. Preserve explicit pause and process-exit receipts in those tasks.
